object: virtual append-only byte stream over immutable segments and an atomic manifest
commit_point: successful conditional manifest replacement or creation
idempotency: bind request id to payload bytes and expected-offset intent; preserve original receipt forever within manifest capacity

properties.append.manifest_valid: ordered contiguous entries, unique ids, durable referenced bytes and matching checksums
properties.append.committed_prefix: all committed operation bodies remain present once in commit order
properties.append.acknowledged_durable: every acknowledged receipt names its original durable byte interval
properties.append.snapshot_consistent: a reader returns the bytes fixed by its initially loaded manifest

assumptions: exclusive backing prefix; no external deletion or mutation
limits: bounded interleavings, four operation intents, no modeled weak memory or production HTTP runtime
